summary: A man broke his ankle slipping on ice at the edge of a snowfield between Arapahoe Peak and Neva Ridge while crossing with a group of eight as the slope steepened; Nederland Fire Protection District, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, and the Boulder County Fire Crew used evacuation equipment to carry him to a landing zone, and a helicopter flew him out just before thick fog closed the area (one chopper paramedic left behind for weight)
location: Snowfield between Arapahoe Peak and Neva Ridge
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District (with Rocky Mountain Rescue Group)
notes: DATE PIN — article says "On Sunday, July 13"; embedded image named 2014-NFPD-Neva-ankle-rescue confirms 2014-07-13 (Sunday); zero Boulder 2014-07-13 rows before insert.
